how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Five steps from onboarding to settled returns.

onboard.title: 1. Onboard & Verify
onboard.description: Every stakeholder completes KYC/KYB. Contracts are digitally witnessed, including by a government representative.

fund.title: 2. Fund the Contract
fund.description: Diaspora investors fund the contract through bonds or equity pools. Banks open escrow. DBE co-finances.

deploy.title: 3. Deploy Inputs
deploy.description: Suppliers deliver seeds, fertilizer, and machinery. Escrow releases payment only after geo-verified delivery.

produce.title: 4. Produce & Verify
produce.description: Farmers produce. Harvest is logged, verified, and stored. Warehouse receipts become collateral.

settle.title: 5. Settle & Distribute
settle.description: Export proceeds flow to escrow. Smart contracts distribute returns to investors, suppliers, banks, and farmers.

what.a: NAFI is a digital infrastructure platform that coordinates diaspora investors, commercial banks, the Development Bank of Ethiopia, NAFA, input suppliers, and commercial farmers within a unified smart-contract engine.

howInvest.q: How do I invest as a diaspora member?
howInvest.a: Register, complete KYC, browse open contracts, and commit capital through fixed-return bonds or profit-share equity pools. Minimum investment is $500.

risk.q: What happens if a contract fails?
risk.a: Escrow funds are frozen and arbitration is triggered. NAFA guarantees and sovereign risk-sharing may cover partial losses. All outcomes are transparent on the ledger.

farmer.a: Farmers register through the platform, verify land-use rights, and sign digital contracts with a government witness. Inputs are delivered and financed through escrow.

government.q: How does NAFI align with government priorities?
government.a: NAFI is the digital execution layer of NAFIR, and directly supports HGER 2.0, ACCII, and DAR. It generates forex, formalizes contract farming, and provides real-time policy dashboards.

finalCta.title: Join the infrastructure of Ethiopia's future
finalCta.subtitle: Whether you invest, farm, bank, or govern — NAFI is where capital meets soil.
